metadata.purpose: Remember the candidate minimum and emit it on completion; equal or incomparable comparisons choose the later item.

cardinality.signature: min : (T! x T! -> Number!)? -> T* -> T?
conditions: Cω-inspired successful value-shape notation; terminal and subscription behavior are specified independently.
Only a normally completing source causes an output: one value for seeded reduce, count and toArray; at most one for unseeded reduce, min and max.
No value is emitted during accumulation. Errors and cancellation discard pending results.
An empty source emits no extremum; candidate comparison is against the prior remembered value.

scope.parameters: min in default profile; safe-integer source indices
scope.callbacks: The model requests a correlated callback with {previous, incoming} and source index. An external adapter invokes the reducer, predicate or comparison once; return/throw arrives as an explicit input.
scope.time: No clock, timer or scheduler allocated. Input times and equal-time order are supplied by the source/test environment.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant source and callback/observer reactions; only correlated callback outcomes are legal while Calling.
exclusions: Reentrant synchronous source delivery or cancellation within reducer/predicate/comparer or destination.next.
Throwing finalizers or downstream observers, arbitrary ObservableInput coercion, invalid count/index overflows.
Array mutation by consumers before emission, object property getter side effects, custom comparator reentrancy.
Finite bounded tests are not universal equivalence proofs or a production interpreter.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Connect lazily. Create fresh count/array memory at each subscription; never emit an initial result.

ownership.sharing: Each result subscription owns its own accumulation and index; no replay or sharing is introduced. Payload references are opaque.
ownership.reset: Fresh bookkeeping and a fresh toArray buffer per subscription; any caller-supplied reduce seed is held by identity, not deep-cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Only a matching callback.return or callback.throw can exit Calling; transition outputs are descriptive commands, not executed effects.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between resolved source values: release source without flushing.
Calling/observer-delivery cancellation is outside the accepted profile.

inputs.description: a new result subscriber starts execution
the source delivers one original value

controls.description: remembering a candidate/count/array; no downstream values yet
waiting for a named synchronous callback outcome

rules.nextState: Subscription allocates a fresh local aggregate; no seed or count value is emitted yet.
rules.explanation: Subscription allocates a fresh local aggregate; no seed or count value is emitted yet.

rules.guard: no memory and a safe source index
rules.nextState: Without seed, the first source value becomes memory. It does not invoke a reducer or comparer.
rules.explanation: Without seed, the first source value becomes memory. It does not invoke a reducer or comparer.

rules.guard: count without predicate; safe source index
rules.nextState: Count every source next; retain only the new count and source index. No value is emitted until completion.
rules.explanation: Count every source next; retain only the new count and source index. No value is emitted until completion.

actions: remember one original reference in the ordered array; no output
rules.nextState: Keep a new immutable model snapshot of the values seen so far. Native toArray owns a mutable array, but emits only after completion.
rules.explanation: Keep a new immutable model snapshot of the values seen so far. Native toArray owns a mutable array, but emits only after completion.

rules.guard: memory exists and callback is required; safe index
actions: invoke named callback with retained arguments
rules.nextState: Request exactly one callback, with the remembered value, incoming input and zero-based source index. No callback is run by the pure model.
rules.explanation: Request exactly one callback, with the remembered value, incoming input and zero-based source index. No callback is run by the pure model.

actions: update aggregate from correlated callback outcome; no output
rules.nextState: Store the reducer result, add the predicate truthiness to count, or select the extremum based on comparison sign; still emit nothing.
rules.explanation: Store the reducer result, add the predicate truthiness to count, or select the extremum based on comparison sign; still emit nothing.

rules.nextState: Callback failure forwards the exact thrown value, cancels upstream and discards the pending aggregate.
rules.explanation: Callback failure forwards the exact thrown value, cancels upstream and discards the pending aggregate.

rules.nextState: Only source completion emits the final aggregate once followed by completion, then releases the source.
rules.explanation: Only source completion emits the final aggregate once followed by completion, then releases the source.

rules.guard: no seed and no source values
rules.nextState: Empty unseeded reduce and empty min/max complete without emitting a value.
rules.explanation: Empty unseeded reduce and empty min/max complete without emitting a value.

rules.nextState: Source errors discard the aggregate and preserve the original error identity; no completion follows.
rules.explanation: Source errors discard the aggregate and preserve the original error identity; no completion follows.

actions: unsubscribe source without any terminal notification
rules.nextState: Unsubscription releases the upstream resource silently, without flushing the aggregate.
